reviews.text: This company is amazing! They were so easy to work with and provided excellent communication and customer service. They completed a screened in porch for us and it is beyond incredible!  The crew did an amazing job! We would highly reccomend them to anyone! Thank you for making our outdoor dreams come true! (These pictures just don't do it justice!) Thanks Pat and Dreamcatchers crew!
reviews.author: Angela Paoli

reviews.text: I have been wanting to get my front porch screened in for awhile now.  The business name was catchy so I decided to call to get an estimate.  Patrick and his wife was extremely professional and very informative. They did measurements and scheduled a day and time.  OMG, when I got home from work, they was done and it made my home even more beautiful 😍 🤩   Thanks to this company for making this a reality and affordable.   I would 110% recommend this company! I don't do reviews but I just had to.  Thanks ya'll!
reviews.author: Chris Johnson

reviews.text: We had our patio screened in & we are satisfied with the outcome. Competitive quote, quality work, respectful of your property and they achieved agreed start / completion date... definitely recommend this company.
reviews.author: Gerry Williams

reviews.text: The quality of the work was excellent — craftsmanship and attention to detail were truly impressive, and the finished product met all my expectations. However, communication was poor. If they could improve their communication and customer updates, they would be outstanding, then it would be 5 stars.
reviews.author: L.V

reviews.text: Patrick and his team did patio screen enclosures and they were really did a great job with competitive quote. His team was able to answer all the questions patiently and assist with the requirements i had. It took a while to install screens and vinyl after framing has been done but Patrick was always prompt in his response even in weekends. Post installation support was also good and his team was able to take care of all issues I had. Great work and definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Srikanth Reddy

reviews.text: The company did my Patio Screen Room and they were really professional and did a great job. I look forward to more projects in the future with them.
reviews.author: Paul Dominguez

reviews.text: Pat did a great job on screening in our patio.  He was good with communication and getting the job done quickly.  It looks amazing and I love sitting in there and not getting attacked by bugs.  :)
reviews.author: Elena T

reviews.text: I had a back patio screened in.  I had gotten two other bids.  Patrick's was right in the middle, but very close to my lowest bid.  But when talking to Patrick, I could tell that not only was he professional he was knowledgeable and experienced!   The biggest difference was the other people said that it would take 3 days.  Patrick said that it would take one.  He had pictures of other jobs and how well they had come out.  The guys were courteous and professional.  The job they did was outstanding!  I would hire them again in a minute!  So happy that I choose them!
reviews.author: Patricia Schmits

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. They describe specific projects with the owner and crew named, show varied writing styles, and include a realistic mix of praise and minor constructive feedback. The ratings are consistent and strong across platforms, and the BBB profile shows no complaints.
fake_signals: Low total review volume (18 on Google, 15 on Yelp) could be a target for manipulation, but no specific patterns detected.
authentic_signals: Specific project details (screened-in porch/patio, front porch)
Mention of owner/crew by name (Patrick, Pat, crew)
Mix of perfect and slightly imperfect (4-star) ratings
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across Google and Yelp, showing a strong, stable reputation. BBB A+ rating with no complaints supports legitimacy.
